name: chuan-ma
description: Learn Sichuan mahjong (川麻, 血战到底): beginner lessons, a coached GPU table, a hand calculator, and the deterministic TypeScript rules engine behind them.

scripts.test: npm run test:kernel && npm run smoke
scripts.test:kernel: node --experimental-strip-types kernel/test/win.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types kernel/test/scoring.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types kernel/test/flow.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types kernel/test/settle.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types kernel/test/ready.test.ts
scripts.smoke: node web/smoke.mjs && node web/tiles.smoke.mjs && node web/linkcheck.mjs

visualDeps.note: 视觉回归脚本（visual-baseline / visual-compare / pixel-audit）另外需要 @resvg/resvg-js 与 pngjs；它们装在受管工作区，用 CHUANMA_DEPS 指向该 node_modules 目录即可。

glyphDeps.note: npm run glyphs 用于再生成 web/glyphs.js（牌面汉字轮廓）。需要一个 OFL 授权的中文 TTF/OTF，默认取 .cache/LXGWWenKaiTC-Bold.ttf；来源与授权见 docs/OFL.txt。只有换字体或改字号体系时才需要跑，生成物已入库。抽取脚本会校验运行期 fitPath() 是否支持该字体用到的全部路径命令，不支持就报错退出。
glyphDeps.font: LXGW WenKai TC Bold (霞鹜文楷) — https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenKai
